title: Variance risk premium and VIX term structure (Bollerslev, Tauchen and Zhou 2009; term-structure slope); PENDING the VIX download
registered: 2026-10-20, before the VIX data exists in the repo

signals (month end).VRP: VIX^2 / 12 (monthly implied variance, in % ^2) minus realised variance of ES over the past 21 trading days (sum of squared daily returns x 1e4)
signals (month end).TS: VIX3M / VIX - 1 (negative = inverted term structure, stress)

rules.VR1: long ES/NQ 0.5 each next month when VRP > its trailing 60-month median, else flat
rules.VR2: long ES/NQ next month when VRP > 0, else flat
rules.TS1: long ES/NQ next month when TS < 0 (buy inversion; mean reversion after stress), else flat
rules.TS2: long ES/NQ next month when TS > 0 (calm contango), else flat

selection: per family the best on 2010-06..2022-12; enters only if > 0.3
judgement: EQR book + entrants; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs the reference at run time
